evidence.request:
GET /search?q=PTSKILLTEST<xss>9a3f HTTP/1.1
Host: staging.example.test
Cookie: session=PTSKILLTEST-session-abc
evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK Content-Type: text/html

results for PTSKILLTEST9a3f

findings.remediation: Output-encode user input in HTML context using a context-aware encoding library; deploy a Content-Security-Policy.
reproduction_steps: Send GET /search?q=PTSKILLTEST<xss>9a3f with the test session cookie.
Observe the marker reflected unescaped in the response body.

evidence.request:
GET /api/users?id=1 AND 1=2 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.staging.example.test
Cookie: session=PTSKILLTEST-session-abc

findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for all database access; never concatenate user input into SQL.
reproduction_steps: Send GET /api/users?id=1 AND 1=1 -> response contains data.
Send GET /api/users?id=1 AND 1=2 -> response is empty. Differential confirms injection.

evidence.request:
GET /api/users/2 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.staging.example.test
Cookie: session=PTSKILLTEST-session-abc

findings.remediation: Enforce per-user authorization checks server-side; verify the requesting user owns or is authorized for the requested object id.
reproduction_steps: Observe 200 with another user's email field, indicating missing object-level authorization.

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.25
X-Powered-By: Express
(missing: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options)

findings.remediation: Set HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options; remove X-Powered-By header.
reproduction_steps: Send GET / and inspect response headers.
Confirm absence of HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options and presence of X-Powered-By.

findings.remediation: Disable source map serving in production; restrict access to .map files or remove them from deployed assets.
reproduction_steps: Observe 200 with a source map JSON body exposing client-side source structure.

findings.remediation: Validate redirect targets against an allowlist of trusted hosts; reject absolute URLs in redirect parameters.
reproduction_steps: Observe 302 with Location pointing to the attacker-controlled sink (redirect not followed during detection).

evidence.request:
GET /api/users?file=../../../../etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
Host: api.staging.example.test
Cookie: session=PTSKILLTEST-session-abc

findings.remediation: Canonicalize and validate file paths against an allowlist base directory; reject traversal sequences (..) in user input.
reproduction_steps: Observe response body containing /etc/passwd entries (root:x:0:0:), confirming path traversal.

evidence.request:
POST /render HTTP/1.1
Host: api.staging.example.test
Content-Type: application/json

{"template":"PTSKILLTEST{{7*7}}"}

findings.remediation: Use a logic-less template engine or sandboxed renderer; never pass user input directly into a template expression context.
reproduction_steps: Observe response 'PTSKILLTEST49' — arithmetic was evaluated, confirming SSTI (no data exfil performed).

evidence.response:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/plain

PING 127.0.0.1 (response delayed 3.0s vs baseline 0.2s)

findings.remediation: Avoid passing user input to shell commands; use language-native exec APIs with argument arrays and strict input validation.
reproduction_steps: Probe: GET /ping?host=127.0.0.1;sleep 3 # returns in ~3.0s. Time delta >= 2.5s confirms command injection (time-based, no output exfil).

attack_paths.name: Auth bypass → protected access
attack_paths.impact: Compromise of /login enables unauthorized access to protected user resources.

attack_paths.name: Data exposure via sqli
attack_paths.impact: Finding finding-002 exposes sensitive data via SQL injection.

attack_paths.name: Path traversal → command injection co-location
attack_paths.impact: Server exposes file read and command execution surfaces on the same host; combined risk of full compromise if escalated.

recommendations: [xss] Output-encode user input in HTML context using a context-aware encoding library; deploy a Content-Security-Policy.
[sqli] Use parameterized queries / prepared statements for all database access; never concatenate user input into SQL.
[idor] Enforce per-user authorization checks server-side; verify the requesting user owns or is authorized for the requested object id.
[misconfig] Set HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options; remove X-Powered-By header.
[info_leak] Disable source map serving in production; restrict access to .map files or remove them from deployed assets.
[open_redirect] Validate redirect targets against an allowlist of trusted hosts; reject absolute URLs in redirect parameters.
[path_traversal] Canonicalize and validate file paths against an allowlist base directory; reject traversal sequences (..) in user input.
[ssti] Use a logic-less template engine or sandboxed renderer; never pass user input directly into a template expression context.
[command_injection] Avoid passing user input to shell commands; use language-native exec APIs with argument arrays and strict input validation.
